<thought>Based on the 1H NMR data, the molecule likely contains a para‑methyl phenyl group (singlet 3 H, aromatic 4 H), another phenyl ring (5 H), and a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ segment between the carbonyl and the second phenyl (two triplets, 2 H each). This fits the structure p‑tolyl‑CO‑CH₂‑CH₂‑Ph, whose SMILES is “Cc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)CCc2ccccc2”.</thought>
<final_answer>Cc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
